lines.en: My black-and-white patches drift across the grass.
Four hooves cross the muddy yard.
Tail swishing, in no hurry.
Doing a circuit of the pasture fence.
My neck dips, then lifts again.
I leave the grass cropped even.
Each step swings my heavy belly.
I step around a fresh pat.
Heading slowly toward the barn.
A chicken is following behind me.
My shadow lies short at my feet.
My hooves click on the flagstones.

lines.zh: 风把我的花斑吹得发亮
lines.en: Wind brightens the sheen on my patches.
I pause once, then keep walking.
I smell of grass and milk.
I turn into the taller grass.
Standing and chewing cud, tail swaying.
I rest my chin on the fence rail.
Gazing at the barn doorway.
A fly settles on my back.
My ears twitch, then still.
I blink twice, slowly.
Dust settles on my black-white coat.
A low moo rises in my throat.

lines.zh: 身体重心从左边换到右边
lines.en: My weight shifts from left to right.
Grass at my lips, but I don't bite.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠似的响鼻
lines.en: I snort something like a yawn.
Another cow chews nearby.
Standing still, sun on my back.
Now and then my tail flicks.

lines.zh: 草吃得差不多，该回去了。
lines.en: Grass is about done. Time to head back.

lines.zh: 我把头低了低，又抬起来
lines.en: I lower my head, then raise it.

lines.zh: 抬起湿漉漉的鼻子看你
lines.en: I lift my wet nose toward you.
You're earlier than yesterday.
My nose twitches at your hand.
I tip my head.
My patched flank faces you.
My look stays calm.

lines.zh: 隔着栏杆，我盯着那把草。
lines.en: Through the fence, I eye that grass.
I know that bucket in your hand.
No call, no retreat.
My tail flicks behind me.

lines.zh: 耳朵朝你的方向转了转
lines.en: My ears angle toward you.

lines.zh: 我继续嚼，眼睛还看着你
lines.en: Still chewing, still watching you.
That hurt. I let out a moo.
I pull back, trembling.
Herdmates turn to look at me.
That blow landed on my back.

lines.zh: 我身上的花斑一抖一抖。
lines.en: My patches shake as I shudder.
The wound in my side stings.
I retreat toward the fence.
My breath and steps both falter.
The pain drives me back toward the fence.
I'll remember that one.
Wheat! I know that smell.
I want everything in that bucket.
My four hooves speed up a little.
I'm coming right up to the bucket.
I lower my head first.
Don't hold it high. I can't reach.
That mouthful goes down so well.

lines.zh: 同伴也看见你手里的了
lines.en: A herdmate spotted your hand too.
Crumbs coat my muzzle.
Finish this and I'll walk with you.
Grass doesn't compare to this.
My nose presses the bucket rim.
Set the bucket down and I'll relax.
No rush. I'll eat slowly.
When it's gone I'll stand here waiting.
That handful will keep me chewing.
Something bumped my belly.
I'm heavy. Hard to shift.
You stepped on my hoof.
I turn sideways to let you by.
My tail caught you. My apologies.
Narrow by the fence. Squeeze past.

lines.zh: 这一下不痛，就是吓了一跳
lines.en: No pain, just a startle.
Stand still. Don't shove.
Shoulder to shoulder. Let me through.
I shift away, still chewing.
I lay my head along her back.
My ear brushes hers.
We walk to the trough together.
She swishes her tail at me.
I low softly, and she answers.
This calf will grow strong.
We stand side by side, still.
She goes first. I follow.

lines.zh: 谷仓的干草够我们过冬
lines.en: The hay in the barn will see us through winter.
Just being quiet together is enough.
One curl of my tongue and the grass is in.
I chew slowly, but I chew it all.
This mouthful tastes a little sweet.
A long stem dangles from my muzzle.
I sniff before I open my mouth.
Full, and there's still some left.
I pick up what fell too.

lines.zh: 同伴凑过来，我让了一半
lines.en: A herdmate leans in and I share half.
Chewing makes me drowsy.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞满，还在找下一口
lines.en: Mouth full, hunting the next bite.
Something's getting closer.
I raise my head mid-chew.
A herdmate stops too.
Those footsteps don't sound right.
I call the calf closer to me.
The herd draws into a cluster.
Just watching. Don't want to bolt.
Every ear stands up at once.
I ease back half a step.
My nostrils blow out a puff.
I watch you and hold still.
The herd presses backward.
I stand at the front.
My hoof scrapes the dirt, restless.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，我们就动一下
lines.en: Each of your steps sets us shifting.
I'm working out what you want.
My breathing grows heavier.
The calf hides behind me.
The grass rustles under our hooves.
Any nearer and we run.
I butt you with my horn.
My forehoof rises and comes down.
My tail slaps your hand.
I turn broadside to block you.
That wasn't my full weight.
After the shove I back off.
My horn sweeps past your waist.
I only want you to keep your distance.

lines.zh: 蹄子扬起的土糊了你一脸
lines.en: My hooves kick dirt into your face.
After that I'm panting.
One more dairy cow at the pasture edge.
I plant my hooves in the grass.
My black-white patches catch the light first.

lines.zh: 我朝谷仓的方向看了一眼
lines.en: I glance toward the barn.
Another cow answers from far off.
I dip my head for a first few bites.
I flick my tail. No flies yet.
My prints line up neatly in the dirt.
The grass here is thicker than I recall.
I start off at an easy pace.
My coat singes and I rear back.
A hoof slips as I land.
Underwater I can't catch a breath.
The blast knocks me off balance.
Something sticks in my shoulder.
A wave of numbness.
Too hungry to stand straight.
Lightning buckles my legs.
It gives way; I fall.
